name: scdaw_manage_labels
description: Add, update, list, remove, or clear point, region, and spectral project labels, or split audio clips at label boundaries.

startBeat.description: Start beat position of the label

endBeat.description: End beat position (equals startBeat for point label, > startBeat for region label)

lowFrequency.description: Optional lower spectral frequency bound in Hz

highFrequency.description: Optional upper spectral frequency bound in Hz

color.description: Optional CSS color hex string for the label flag

trackId.description: Optional target audio track ID for action='split_at_labels'

includeRegionEnds.description: When splitting at labels, also split at region endBeat positions
